purpose: Audit whether the Constitutional Capitalism machine is structurally complete — by function, not chapter title. Close only true structural holes. Certify Stage 1 skeleton at 100%.
audit_posture: Not a construction pass. Not a research campaign. Not endless detail. Disposition every essential function.

hole_standard.a_structural_hole_exists_only_when: We must answer 'How does this political-economic system perform an essential function?' and there is currently no answer or structural home.

disposition_scheme.CLOSED: Structural home exists — Stage 1 satisfied for this function
disposition_scheme.HOLE: System cannot be explained without resolving before Stage 1 closes
disposition_scheme.STAGE_2: Structure exists; working model needs development
disposition_scheme.STAGE_3: Model exists; needs full unabridged treatment
disposition_scheme.STAGE_4: Requires evidence, legal testing, modeling, or stress testing

complete_system_architecture_map.one_sentence: Constitutional Capitalism is four integrated spines under foundations: Money & Ownership produces and retains surplus under anti-extraction rules; Household & Place converts surplus into household capability and place foundations; Government & Democratic Power authorizes, constrains, funds, and protects against capture; Transition, Resilience & Measurement moves Arkansas through time under the Dependency Rule while measuring whether households actually gain.
complete_system_architecture_map.power_loop: People → Constitution → Democracy → Government → Resources → Outcomes → Measurement → Accountability → People
complete_system_architecture_map.capture_loop: Concentrated wealth → political money → government → preferential rules → contracts/assets → more concentrated wealth
complete_system_architecture_map.dependency_rule: Build the bridge before removing the old road
complete_system_architecture_map.transition_map: ARKANSAS NOW → YEARS 1–2 → YEARS 3–5 → YEARS 6–10 → GENERATION 1 → GENERATION 2

function_matrix.closure_question: How do people choose, constrain, replace, and directly overrule government?
What can government never violate, even in pursuit of prosperity?
How are laws, agencies, boards, procurement and services actually operated?
How does government sustainably fund itself?
function_matrix.note: Architecture home exists; COUNTABLE engines remain $0 — validation later, not a skeleton hole

function_matrix.closure_question: How does capital get created, allocated, financed and retained?
Who owns productive assets and who receives their surplus?
How are markets kept competitive, innovative and resistant to extraction/capture?
How do people move from work to skills to ownership to entrepreneurship?
How are housing, food, healthcare, energy, mobility, childcare and basic security structurally addressed?
How does Arkansas continuously increase human capability?
How are transportation, water, energy, digital and physical systems built and maintained?
How do rural, urban, county, municipal and regional economies remain viable?
How does the system protect people, enforce rules and restore productive participation?
How does Arkansas retain people, attract people, support families and increase inherited capital?
How does Arkansas earn income from outside rather than merely circulate internal dollars?
function_matrix.note: External-income architecture home exists; feeder evidence gated — not a missing organ

function_matrix.closure_question: How do we know whether households, communities and Arkansas itself are actually becoming more prosperous?
What happens when revenues, markets, technology, climate, demographics or institutions are stressed?
function_matrix.note: Connected in skeleton; five-state attack battery is Stage 4 — not a hole

function_matrix.closure_question: How do we move from today's Arkansas without destabilizing existing obligations or essential systems?
What prevents accumulated economic power from purchasing political power and reversing the system?
How does Arkansas detect failure and KEEP / REFORM / PHASE OUT / ELIMINATE / CREATE NEW?

money_flow_continuity.statement: Every major proposal has a path into the larger Arkansas money system: production/external demand → ownership/market rules → credit/capital → public income engines → household/community ledgers → geographic accounting → measurement — with leakage and capture explicitly tracked as failure modes.

time_continuity.statement: Every major transformation has a station on ARKANSAS NOW → Years 1–2 → 3–5 → 6–10 → Generation 1 → Generation 2. Timelines are not deeply filled — places exist.

stage_1_certification.statement: Stage 1 — Full Skeleton is COMPLETE. Every essential political-economic function has a structural home. True structural holes open at certification: 0.
